title: Twindling Tweaks: Decor
description: This is an addon for Twindling Tweaks that adds a bunch of decorative blocks!
body:
Welcome back to Twindling Tweaks, this time with an addon that makes it fresh! This is the decoration addon for Twindling Tweaks.

Twindling Tweaks: Decor is an addon for Twindling Tweaks and my very first addon mod!

This mod adds just about everything you can think of to decorate your builds with, all while utilizing existing resources from Twindling Tweaks!

Some of the decoration blocks it includes are Alluminite and Luminium Bricks and Pillars, Compressed Mud and Dried Mud Bricks, Obsidian and Reinforced Obsidian Bricks, and Stair, Slab, Wall, Pressure Plate, Button, Fence, and Fence Gate variants for the brick, pillar, and standard variants of the blocks.

This is the first addon for Twindling Tweaks of many!

Stay tuned, because there will be lots more addons to come!
